episodes.synopsis: Spy-school washout Lily just accepted a provisional graduation, and she couldn’t be happier! But there’s more to her new assignment (and her new teacher) than meets the eye.
episodes.title: MISSION: Flower Garden I

episodes.synopsis: From defeat comes wisdom. To vanquish Klaus, Team Lamplight must learn from their mistakes — but once they enter enemy territory, the time for mistakes will be over.
episodes.title: MISSION: Flower Garden II

episodes.synopsis: Impossible Mission or not, it doesn’t make sense for a team that legendary to go down so easily. A traitor betrays his team.
episodes.title: MISSION: Flower Garden III

episodes.synopsis: Nine elite members form a new team called Lamplight, and they’re going to pick up where Inferno left off.
episodes.title: FILE: Fool Erna

episodes.synopsis: With Wunderkind Lily at its head, Lamplight's going to lead the charge. Their inaugural Impossible Mission is just around the corner.
episodes.title: FILE: Lamplight Days

episodes.synopsis: The girls receive some advice: “Deceive each other. Trick each other. Improve each other.”
episodes.title: FILE: Pandemonium Sybilla

episodes.synopsis: With a ghost on the loose and a literal ticking time bomb, the girls start worrying about the manor's structural integrity.
episodes.title: FILE: Meadow Sara

episodes.synopsis: Coming back from a break, everyone is recharged and ready for the next mission. Lamplight's been promoted from a provisional team to an actual team.
episodes.title: MISSION: Daughter Dearest I

episodes.synopsis: When you’re a spy, sometimes being stealthy is not enough. You also have to be well fed!
episodes.title: MISSION: Daughter Dearest II

episodes.synopsis: During the Pre-Impossible Mission Planning, the assassins make their way into the manor disguised as delivery people.
episodes.title: MISSION: Daughter Dearest III

episodes.synopsis: Lamplight faces a battle they have to win on their own.
episodes.title: MISSION: Daughter Dearest IV

episodes.synopsis: This will be the first time in a long while that all nine Lamplight members back together!
episodes.title: FILE: Daughter Dearest Grete
